_about: be•do V53 facts: choice strings, glyphs, orders and thresholds that hold nothing personal. Read at run time by the core and the builders; a chat reads it instead of recalling a string. Personal values (base ids, field ids, names) live in facts_local.json, gitignored; facts_local.example.json is its blank shape. Select strings were copied from the live schema, 4 Oct 2026. Change a string here only after the base changed, never before.

key.about: YYMMDD_HHMM of the first entry, a letter on collision. Only ⚡ action rows with an action status carry one.

clock.about: Every stream datetime is stored UTC with a Z; the local offset comes from facts_local, checked against the time zone on the day (I12).

flows.order_source: the practices catalog's order field, filtered to active; never recited
flows.about_sequences: Her stated orders, which beat any observed median. 4 Oct 2026: morning movement is early, with the coffee (easy waking-up movements); morning sun comes before the exercise block (hips, strength, breaths); water after the first coffee. Within the block the observed times decide. Dusk is ordered by clock time.
flows.about_core: A228, 2 Oct 2026: the core prints one line each in a code block; every other remaining step goes on ONE line underneath. Nothing leaves the catalog and everything counts toward done. The dusk core is not set yet (null prints every step as core).

about_widget: A237, 2 Oct 2026: the remaining list on a widget surface is a pill strip. Dawn's bar is #EFA038, the marigold she named for spirit; dusk's is #7B6FD6, the blue-violet of the ☑️ box — her words 4 Oct 2026: dusk should be more of a purple, something like ☑️.

dusk_audit.attention_rule: a row sharing minutes with another row is 🌓 partial: both are recorded in full, nothing is beaten out (9 Oct 2026). Otherwise a discrete session (an end datetime) is 🌕 full; a session written as time spent because it spanned gaps is 🌓 partial (A262)

self_check.attention_pool: ✅ done and ▶️ in motion ⚡ action chains with a real span in the window
self_check.people_pool: contact rows (face-to-face, video call, phone, text) with a person tagged

catalog_standings.about: be•do never sets a standing unasked; a reading item clear-inbox files is the one exception (stories, want)

meals._about: Her rules, 7 Oct 2026 (the meals amendment): an educated guess, not a hard rule, and the onus is on be•do, not on her logging every minute. be•do places each meal's prep and eating from context, writes them ESTIMATED FROM CONTEXT, and tells her what went in the record so she can say if it is accurate.

prep_why.simple: a simple meal she made, like a sandwich
prep_why.straightforward: a really straightforward dinner she cooked
prep_why.cooked: a dinner she cooked; most take 45 minutes to an hour

meals.about_family_words: A meal in a family possessive (Mom's cornbread) was made by them, not ordered and not hers to prep: the eating is placed, no prep row is proposed (8 Oct).

fill._about: Rule 1 of the 9 Oct amendment, in code (the fill_gaps rules): every row is written with device and wellness, deduced at write time. Wellness: an ⚡ action on a drive takes the drive's element, else the practice's catalog wellness. Device: body and self-care practices 🚫 none, phone practices 📱 phone, 💻 laptop when the title says so, 🚫 none inside a walking, driving, cycling or location span. What can't be deduced is asked, in the same reply, never left empty. Personal practices extend these lists in facts_local under fill.

entry_rules._about: The 9 Oct amendment, rules 2 and 6, and the 8 Oct one that every row carries a practice. A row's datetime and end fall on one local day and span at most max_span_hours; closing an old chain row sets its datetime to the act, never a multi-day span from its first date. A night's sleep is the one row that crosses midnight. person is for people she was with or in direct contact with; a plan (▫️ ⬜) names them in mentioned until it happens.

dayqa._about: run_checks.sh dayqa DATE: meals, gaps, movement, people and device in one list. Every fill is ESTIMATED FROM CONTEXT and names its source; the dusk close shows it, writes only what she accepts, and carries the marker line in its [be•do] block. The look behind will not build a day whose rows don't carry the marker.

sources.usual: your usual, from your past weeks

dayqa.about_movement_words: Only words that mean movement whatever the sentence: 'run' and 'running' read as running the checks on 6 Oct.
dayqa.about_note_practices: A clue inside an unlogged stretch is a note of hers, a photo, a message or Oura. A routine tick logged as a moment (a coffee, phone charging) says nothing about the stretch around it: on 8 Oct a 3 a.m. phone-charging row would have filled four hours.

synergy._about: Her rule, 24 Aug 2026, and her words 9 Oct: when two things run at once, are they synergizing or competing? Four answers — synergizing (one plus one makes four), competing (one plus one makes one), both, neutral — and declining is always fine. The answer is a note, not a field: one line at the end of her words, 'overlap — synergizing with <key or title>'. be•do helps her notice: synergy, do more of that; competing, try them apart. Asked only when the answer isn't already in her words or her past weeks, and then once, optional.

say.competing: competing — next time, try them apart
say.both: some of each — notice which part helped
say.neutral: they just sat side by side
